description: Model call/put profit and loss at expiry — break-evens, max profit and max loss for any number of contracts.

faqs.a: Call P/L per share = max(price − strike, 0) − premium. Put P/L per share = max(strike − price, 0) − premium. Multiply by 100 shares per contract and your contract count.
Call break-even = strike + premium; put break-even = strike − premium. Past that price the position turns profitable at expiry.
Long call max profit is theoretically unlimited; long put max profit = (strike − premium) × 100 × contracts; max loss for both = premium paid.
faqs.q: What are max profit and max loss?

howto: Pick call or put, then enter strike, premium and contracts.
Drag the price-at-expiry slider (or type a price).
Read P/L, break-evens, max profit and max loss.
title: Options Profit Calculator
